configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Distributable build. x86-64-v3 baseline (AVX2/BMI2, Haswell and Zen onward) plus LTO. This is what you publish.

configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.description: Tuned for the building machine. Use for local SPRT and benchmarking; the binary may crash on other CPUs, so never distribute it.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: No optimization, no LTO, asserts live. Use for the incremental-hash assertion and anything involving a debugger.

configurePresets.name: tests
configurePresets.description: Optimized build of the GoogleTest suite, so perft finishes in seconds rather than minutes.

testPresets.name: fast
testPresets.description: Everything except the perft suite — a few milliseconds, for use as a pre-commit check.
